newsitem.title: USA: USA Detergents another shareholder suit.
newsitem.headline: USA Detergents another shareholder suit.

text.p: Two New York law firms said Friday that they have filed suit in the United States District Court for the District of New Jersey, to recover damages from USA Detergents Inc on behalf of shareholders.

The complaint alleges that, among things, the company backdated at least $4 million of shipments in the third quarter of 1996 to meet analysts' earnings estimates, and that it misrepresented material information about its distribution problems, which were revealed to the investing public on Feb. 5.
Company officials were not immedaitely available for comment Friday afternnon.
The suit is the fourth in recent months against the company, whose stock price reached a high of $48 in the past year. It closed Friday at 12-5/8.
